plan.title: School Enrolment & Infrastructure Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Trends in student enrolment, gender gaps, and infrastructure readiness across schools

panels.title: Total students enrolled (2024)
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Girls 2024") + SUM("Boys 2024") AS total_students FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"

panels.title: Girls vs Boys ratio (2024)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM("Girls 2024") * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM("Boys 2024"), 0)), 1) AS ratio FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"

panels.title: Enrolment trend by gender (2022-2024)
panels.sql:
WITH yearly_data AS (
  SELECT 'Girls' AS gender, "Girls 2022" AS count, '2022' AS year FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Girls', "Girls 2023", '2023' FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Girls', "Girls 2024", '2024' FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Boys' AS gender, "Boys 2022" AS count, '2022' FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Boys', "Boys 2023", '2023' FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Boys', "Boys 2024", '2024' FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
)
SELECT gender, year, SUM(count) AS total FROM yearly_data GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1

panels.title: Top 10 schools by enrolment growth (2022-2024)
panels.sql:
WITH growth_data AS (
  SELECT 
    "School Name", 
    "Block", 
    ("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024") - ("Girls 2022" + "Boys 2022") AS growth
  FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
)
SELECT 
  "School Name", 
  "Block", 
  growth
FROM growth_data
ORDER BY growth DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Infrastructure gaps by block
panels.sql:
SELECT 
  "Block", 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'No' THEN 1 END) AS non_functional_toilets,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "Drinking water" = 'No' THEN 1 END) AS no_water_supply,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "Electricity" = 'No' THEN 1 END) AS no_electricity
FROM "school_infrastructure"
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Schools with functional toilets (girls)
panels.sql:
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'Yes' THEN 'Functional' ELSE 'Non-functional' END AS toilet_status,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM "school_infrastructure"
GROUP BY 1

plan.narrative: This dashboard tracks key metrics for school performance across {{p1.id}} districts. The gender ratio shows {{p2}} girls for every 100 boys in 2024, highlighting persistent gender gaps. Enrolment trends reveal {{p3}} students grew by {{p3.n}} between 2022 and 2024, with {{p4}} schools showing the most significant increases. Infrastructure data exposes critical gaps: {{p5.non_functional_toilets}} schools lack functional girls' toilets, while {{p5.no_water_supply}} and {{p5.no_electricity}} schools face basic service deficiencies. Only {{p6.Functional}}% of schools meet minimum toilet standards, requiring urgent attention to improve learning environments.
